lighting_notes: Softer than the operating room but still clinical — slightly warmer to mark the time shift ('LATER'), but keep it muted, not comforting. Doctor's face needs to read as 'pale and grave' — a cooler rim/fill on him specifically would help sell that.
action: Ananya wakes up. The Doctor stands beside her bed, his face pale and grave. He delivers the news. A tear falls silently down Ananya's cheek.

dialogue.line: There was a severe surgical complication during the procedure. Your uterine wall ruptured.
To save your life... we had no choice but to perform an emergency hysterectomy. Your uterus was removed. I am so sorry.

continuity_notes: Key plot turn — this complication is the detail Mr. Sharma reacts to in sc08 ('a secret procedure that leaves you sterile'). The single silent tear is the only physical performance beat; needs a clean, held close_up, no camera movement, to land.
